mainText: Hello, Verona! At 7 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We are looking at 76 degrees with partly cloudy skies near the Military Ridge State Trail. The moon is in a waxing crescent phase. Tonight, we will dip to an overnight low of 68 degrees with no rain predicted.

The Verona Senior Center is currently recruiting volunteers to help with their services. They require a commitment of at least two shifts per month and have a variety of roles available, some of which may involve light physical activity. They emphasize a strict policy on confidentiality and integrity for all volunteers.

There is a lot happening in the area! Today, you can visit the Dane County Farmers Market or catch live music at Bailey's Run, Paddy Mac's, and the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, check out the Cave Carnival at Cave of the Mounds or the Girls Try Hockey event at the Verona Ice Arena.
In a noteworthy call from Wednesday, August 6, a Verona officer stopped a vehicle for erratic driving and subsequently arrested the driver for a fourth offence O W I.
Today's flavor of the day is the classic Turtle. Culver's is open until 10:30 PM tonight, so you have plenty of time to stop by and enjoy a delicious treat.
